name: Post-Matric Scholarship 2025-26 (simulated)
description: Synthetic scholarship disbursement ledger plus post-payout money transfers. Names, addresses, phones, Aadhaar numbers (valid Verhoeff checksums) and bank details follow realistic Indian formats. Families, twins, CSC centres and college fee accounts create legitimate sharing. Ring and lone ghosts were planted afterwards with labels kept in a separate file the detector never reads.

ringTypes.description: Unrelated identities paying out to 1-2 bank accounts, registered in a burst from one IP
Payouts routed to one collector UPI ID; templated disposable emails

Burst of registrations from one IP with batch phones and templated emails
Batch phone numbers paying into a shared account

Students paying fees to a college account (legitimate fan-in of money)
Siblings paid into a parent's account
Twins: same DOB, father and address, often rhyming names
Genuine user with many failed logins over a longer window

Genuine applicant whose Aadhaar was mistyped at data entry (checksum fails)

howCreated: Generated households of students with realistic names, DOBs, addresses, phones, Aadhaar numbers and bank accounts.
Added legitimate look-alikes for every ghost signal: families, twins, CSC centres, college fee accounts, phone typos, expired-but-genuine Aadhaar, forgetful logins.
Planted 35 rings across 9 types and 200 lone ghosts with 5 trait types. Each ring signal is carried by only part of the ring, with gaps and cross-district members.
Held two ring types (slow_drip, identity_reuse) out of tuning; a separate test set with a different seed and shifted sizes, noise and rates is used once for the reported numbers.
Shuffled records and assigned IDs afterwards so order and IDs reveal nothing.

pipeline.description: Group records by pincode, phone prefix and name initials to avoid comparing every pair.
Levenshtein + phonetic names; exact match on account, UPI, biometric, phone, IP, email template.
Records, accounts, UPI IDs, phones, IPs and addresses become nodes; shared attributes and transfers become edges.
Louvain community detection, cycle detection on transfers, fan-in to collectors, IP burst windows.
Aadhaar checksum and status, phone validity and duplication, login behaviour, combined.
Top contributing signals become reasons, red table cells and an explainable risk index.

limitations: Real welfare fraud labels are not public, so the ledger is simulated.
Results are on simulated fraud plus component benchmarks, not on real welfare data.
